answer: One concrete defense is reputation-weighted voting plus cluster detection on the trust graph. Each identity's weight is earned through long, independent history, and the network measures how tightly new accounts only vouch for one another. A clique that sprang up overnight and trades only inside itself looks nothing like an honest community, so its weight collapses before it can climb the summit of influence. One veteran whose judgment survived dozens of epochs still outweighs a thousand hollow identities on the same knoll; only years of earned links carry a name to its zenith.
